scientific_scope_status: A fixed rank-r subspace tracking an N-site normalized guided phase vector with uniform residual<=epsilon on phase width0<W<=2pi must satisfy r>=(1-epsilon^2)*N*W/(2pi) and a KyFan covariance capture condition. This is a representation constraint, not a count of physical poles or a gate certificate. Analytic variation bounds can enclose a chosen projected excitation and ideal angular radiation when their grid inputs are validated. At Bragg, equal reciprocal guided columns leave one photon input unchanged, giving error2 against the relative -I target. A smooth reciprocal nondegenerate one-orbital band also has zero slope there. Off-Bragg/multiband changes evade these restricted premises but do not certify full scattering. A separate Markov cavity model exposes full-output loss/cooperativity/bandwidth costs.
